PROMPT: FLOVA — "THE DIRECTOR OF REALITY"  Duration: 60 Seconds  Aspect Ratio: 16:9  Genre: Premium AI Creative Platform Commercial  Style: Hollywood cinematic advertisement, futuristic creativity, ultra-realistic VFX, seamless AI world generation, Apple/Nike-level brand film quality. CHARACTER CONSISTENCY (ALL SCENES) The Director Maintain the exact same character throughout every scene.  A young creative visionary in his late 20s/early 30s.  Appearance:  same face identity in every shot  warm expressive eyes  slightly messy dark hair  transparent stylish glasses oversized beige jacket oversized cream shirt loose brown tie baggy faded blue jeans chunky cream sneakers silver rings and bracelets necklace and dog tag vintage camera hanging from shoulder headphones around neck Personality: playful curious  imaginative  confident experimental He is not a corporate businessman. He is the person who turns impossible ideas into reality. PART 1 (0–15s)  THE EMPTY STAGE — A WORLD WAITING TO EXIST  A massive cinematic soundstage sits completely empty.  A huge black floor stretches endlessly. Soft fog moves across the ground.  Dust particles float through golden studio lights.  Empty cameras, concept sketches, and unfinished ideas surround the space.  The Director slowly walks into the center.  Camera:  opening aerial drone shot revealing the enormous empty studio  slow cinematic dolly forward following him  low-angle hero shot as he enters the light close-up on his eyes as inspiration sparks He looks around at the empty world. He smiles. Raises his hand.  Quietly says:  "Action."  The studio begins transforming.  The floor cracks open with glowing creative energy.  Reality starts being created around him.  PART 2 (15–30s)  DIRECTING IMPOSSIBLE WORLDS  The soundstage transforms into a breathtaking medieval fantasy kingdom.  Massive castles rise from the ground. Ancient forests grow instantly.  Magical particles fill the sky.  A giant dragon flies above the Director.  The world feels like a blockbuster fantasy movie.  Camera:  FPV camera flying through castle towers  sweeping aerial shot over the kingdom  360-degree orbit around The Director dramatic low-angle shot as the dragon passes overhead The Director calmly watches his creation. He says: "Cut."  The world freezes.  The kingdom breaks apart into beautiful glowing particles, digital fragments, and cinematic layers.  The pieces collapse like an editable creative project.  He says:  "Action."  Instant transformation.  The particles explode into a futuristic cyberpunk city.  Neon skyscrapers surround him.  Flying vehicles move between buildings.  Rain falls through glowing holograms.  Camera:  fast tracking shot through neon streets  close-up of his hand controlling the transformation  spinning camera move around him as the city forms PART 3 (30–45s) INFINITE CREATION The Director moves faster. Every command creates a new universe. "Cut."  The cyberpunk city folds like paper and disappears.  "Action."  He appears underwater.  A massive underwater civilization surrounds him.  Giant whales swim between futuristic ruins.  Blue light shines through the ocean.  Camera:  underwater cinematic tracking shot  slow-motion whale movement  close-up reaction shot of The Director "Cut." The ocean transforms into flowing digital particles. "Action."  He appears on Mars.  Red deserts stretch endlessly.  A futuristic colony rises behind him.  Spaceships fly above.  Camera:  wide planetary establishing shot  drone orbit around Mars landscape  hero silhouette shot against the planet The transitions become faster: Action. Anime-inspired universe.  Dynamic colors.  Stylized landscapes.  Energy effects.  Action.  Luxury fashion runway.  Premium lighting.  High-fashion cinematic shots.  Action.  Giant toy city.  Colorful buildings.  Playful miniature world.  Every universe feels like a completely different film.  PART 4 (45–60s)  THE FLOVA REVEAL  The worlds begin appearing faster.  Fantasy. Sci-fi.  Animation.  Fashion.  Adventure.  Hundreds of realities surround The Director.  The camera spins around him traveling through multiple universes.  Everything suddenly stops.  Silence.  The worlds collapse into glowing particles.  Camera:  Extreme wide shot slowly pulling backward.  The audience realizes:  He was never inside these worlds.  He was creating them.  FINAL REVEAL — FLOVA INTERFACE  The camera continues pulling back.  The Director is sitting at a modern creative workstation.  A laptop sits in front of him.  The screen displays the actual Flova interface.  Use the provided Flova UI reference image.  The interface must match:  exact layout  exact workspace structure  real panels  real buttons real navigation real typography real colors Do not create a generic AI dashboard. The laptop screen should clearly look like the official Flova platform. The screen shows his created projects:  fantasy kingdom  cyberpunk city  underwater world  Mars scene animation world fashion commercial Multiple generated creations organized inside Flova. Camera: macro close-up of the Flova interface on the laptop screen  realistic glass reflections  shallow depth of field over-the-shoulder shot showing The Director using Flova slow cinematic orbit around him as the screen lights his face He clicks one button. The screen glows. All realities return behind him.  The Director stands surrounded by infinite worlds.  FINAL FRAME  The camera pulls back into a massive cinematic universe.  The Director stands at the center.  The Flova logo appears.  Text:  "Don't imagine worlds. Direct them."  VISUAL REQUIREMENTS  4K HDR  ultra-realistic cinematic quality  seamless world transitions realistic physics volumetric lighting premium commercial cinematography fast energetic editing emotional storytelling consistent character identity realistic Flova interface reveal Core feeling: One creator. A few weeks ago, we had the example of Dodik regime propagandists in Srebrenica falsely using the photograph of a boy murdered in Serbia in 2008 as a purported example of a ‘Serb victim’ a fictitious pogrom of the Serb community in eastern Bosnia during the Bosnian War.  Now, we have one of the most prominent Serb nationalist disinfo accounts on this platform falsely using the image of Captain Nusret Sahanić of the Army of the Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina as a “[warrior] against Radical Islam”. 

These are not accidents. 

Yes, they are examples of a disregard for actual victims of war, including actual Serb(ian) civilians. But that disregard is intentional because the Serbian nationalist propaganda narrative actually depends on misinformation and the peddling of, at best, half-truths. 

That’s how you end up with paintings passed off as photographs during the 1990s, photographs of Bosniak refugees misappropriated by the highest levels of the Serbian government in 2023, and the actions in question here. And hundreds of similar instances. These are intentional efforts to muddy the facts of the genocide in Bosnia, and the broader nature of the Bosnian War to legitimate the political goals of the regimes in Banja Luka and Belgrade.

Contrast that to the scientific and scholarly efforts undertaken by actual experts. Works such as “The Bosnian Book of the Dead” by @MTokaca which remains the standard reference text of the total death count of the Bosnian War; the work of @TheICMP, which revolutionized the use DNA in the identification of Bosniak victims in Srebrenica, identifying other Bosnian victims from other Bosnian killing fields, and today far beyond; or the scholarship and memorialization work of @SrebrenicaMC, arguably the premier genocide and atrocity research institution in Europe today. 

The contrast is stark at every level. But at base it is between the sorts of lies peddled by the account below, and those struggling to preserve the truth - against ongoing regime repression.

A 22 year old from the UK asked Claude one question.

Not "how do I grow on TikTok."

Not "what hashtags work."

Just this:

"What's the actual blueprint for a million views?"

Claude's answer sounded almost too simple.

Build a virtual model.

Asian features.

Set her to trending dances.

Over popular tracks.

That's it.

No strategy deck.

No growth hacks.

No paid ads.

He read it and thought: pointless.

Felt like a shortcut with no substance behind it.

Most people would've closed the chat right there.

He didn't.

He tested it anyway.

Because that's the difference.

Everyone has access to the same AI.

Everyone can ask the same question.

Almost nobody follows through on the boring, weird-sounding answer.

The people who win aren't smarter.

They're just willing to try the thing that sounds stupid before it works.

Save this before you scroll past the next "obvious" idea that isn't.

Why do AI-generated videos often look good but break physics? 

Google researchers (with University of Copenhagen and Oxford) introduce VGGRPO—a new method that trains a latent geometry model to directly read scene depth and motion from a video diffusion model’s internal representations. 

Then it uses reinforcement learning to reward smooth camera paths and consistent 3D geometry. 

Result: VGGRPO outperforms prior approaches in camera stability, geometry consistency, and overall quality—while eliminating expensive VAE decoding. 

VGGRPO: Towards World-Consistent Video Generation with 4D Latent Reward
